## Version 1.2.0 - Update (02-May-2026)

### Bug fixes

- Fixed an issue where
  [`load_sl4x()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_sl4x.md)
  and
  [`load_harx()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_harx.md)
  returned a `subscript out of bounds` error for macro variables.

### New features

- [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  now supports writing `1C` headers for string-format data.
- [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  now supports writing ViewHAR-recognized mapping headers through the
  new `mappings` argument.
- Added support for writing mixed HAR files containing string sets,
  mapping vectors, numeric data frames, sparse numeric data, and integer
  matrices in a single
  [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  call.
- Added optional `header_type` control for explicitly defining header
  roles when automatic detection is not sufficient.
- Added stricter header-name validation to prevent silent duplication
  after GEMPACK’s four-character header truncation.
- Improved mapping validation: missing or invalid mapping targets are
  written as `"0"` and reported with warnings.
- Clarified the
  [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  interface: `value_cols` is used only for numeric value columns in
  data-frame inputs, while mapping behavior is defined separately
  through `mappings`.
- Updated
  [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  documentation and examples for CRAN-style usage, including
  mixed-header exports and ViewHAR-compatible mapping exports.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Overview

HARplus is an R package designed to process and analyze .HAR and .SL4
files, making it easier for GEMPACK users and GTAP model researchers to
handle large economic datasets. It simplifies the management of multiple
experiment results, enabling faster and more efficient comparisons
without complexity.

With HARplus, users can extract, restructure, and merge data seamlessly,
ensuring compatibility across different tools. The processed data can be
exported and used in R, Stata, Python, Julia, or any software that
supports .txt, CSV, or Excel formats.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Key Features

- **Efficient Data Extraction** – Supports selective header loading and
  optimized memory usage for handling large `.HAR` and `.SL4` files.  
- **Flexible Data Structuring** – Extract variables by name or dimension
  patterns while ensuring consistency across multiple inputs.  
- **Customizable Aggregation & Merging** – Manage subtotals, merge
  datasets, and structure data dynamically.  
- **Multiple Export Options** – Output extracted data in CSV, Stata,
  RDS, and Excel formats with structured formatting.  
- **Powerful HAR Writing** – Includes
  [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  for exporting datasets to GEMPACK `.HAR` format with full binary
  compliance.  
- **Designed for GEMPACK** – Ensures smooth integration with `.HAR` and
  `.SL4` files while offering additional flexibility.  
- **Ideal for GTAP Model Users** – Built specifically to process and
  analyze GTAP model results efficiently.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## How It Works

HARplus simplifies `.HAR` and `.SL4` file processing. You can: - Load
files and selectively extract headers. - Extract data by variable name
or dimension patterns. - Group, merge, and restructure data with ease. -
Pivot and export data into structured formats. - Filter subtotals and
rename dimensions for clarity.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

HARplus (version 1.1.2) can be installed directly in R using:

``` r

install.packages("HARplus")
```

While the latest HARplus (version 1.2.0) can be installed from my GitHub
using:

``` r

devtools::install_github("Bodysbobb/HARplus")
```

## Quick Guide to HARplus

All commands in this package have several options that allow users to
play around with the data more freely and efficiently, not just import
and get the data. For a complete guide on HARplus functions, check out
the **[Vignette](https://rpubs.com/Bodysbob/1273998/)** or **[GitHub
Vignette](https://www.pattawee-pp.com/HARplus/)**

Below is a categorized reference of the main functions in HARplus:

### Data Importing

- **[`load_harx()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_harx.md)**
  – Loads `.HAR` files with selective header extraction and structured
  metadata.  
- **[`load_sl4x()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_sl4x.md)**
  – Loads `.SL4` files, extracting variable names and dimension
  structures.

### Data Extraction

- **[`get_data_by_var()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_data_by_var.md)**
  – Extracts specific variables from `.HAR` or `.SL4` datasets,
  supporting subtotal filtering and merging.  
- **[`get_data_by_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_data_by_dims.md)**
  – Extracts data based on dimension patterns, with options for merging
  and subtotal filtering.

### Data Structure Summary & Comparison

- **[`get_dim_elements()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_dim_elements.md)**
  – Lists unique dimension elements (e.g., `REG`, `COMM`).  
- **[`get_dim_patterns()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_dim_patterns.md)**
  – Extracts unique dimension structures (e.g., `REG*COMM*ACTS`).  
- **[`get_var_structure()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_var_structure.md)**
  – Summarizes variable names, dimensions, and data structure.  
- **[`compare_var_structure()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/compare_var_structure.md)**
  – Compares variable structures across multiple datasets for
  compatibility.

### Data Grouping & Processing

- **[`group_data_by_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/group_data_by_dims.md)**
  – Groups extracted data by dimension priority, with support for
  automatic renaming and subtotal handling.  
- **[`rename_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/rename_dims.md)**
  – Renames dimension names for consistency.

### Data Transformation

- **[`pivot_data()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/pivot_data.md)**
  – Converts long-format data into wide format.  
- **[`pivot_data_hierarchy()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/pivot_data_hierarchy.md)**
  – Creates hierarchical pivot tables for structured reporting.

### Data Export

- **[`export_data()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/export_data.md)**
  – Exports extracted data to CSV, Stata, TXT, RDS, or XLSX, with
  support for multi-sheet exports.

### HAR Exporting (New in v1.1.1)

- **[`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)**
  – Saves processed data frames or arrays into GEMPACK-compatible `.HAR`
  files, automatically generating 1C set headers and supporting up to
  seven dimensions.

#### Technical Specifications

- Supports both **1C (string)** and **RE (real)** headers  
- Automatically generates 1C dimension sets (e.g., `REG`, `COMM`,
  `ENDW`)  
- Accepts data frames or arrays with flexible column naming  
- Writes associated set headers when `export_sets = TRUE`  
- Maintains full GEMPACK binary structure with no size limitation  
- Supports up to seven dimensions and approximately 2 million elements
  per chunk  
- Allows **dimension renaming** and supports **duplicate dimension
  names** (e.g., `COMMxREGxREG`) during export (New in v1.1.2)

### Shock Calculation Framework (New in v1.1.2)

These functions provide a complete workflow to **calculate, structure,
and export GEMPACK-compatible shock files** directly from `.HAR`,
`.SL4`, `.CSV`, or `.XLSX` datasets—eliminating the need for manual
conversion when preparing dynamic simulation shocks.

- **[`shock_calculate_uniform()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate_uniform.md)**
  – Calculates uniform percentage shocks across all base rates and
  **exports directly to GEMPACK `.HAR` format**. Supports additive (`+`,
  `-`) and multiplicative (`*`, `/`) adjustments.  
- **[`shock_calculate()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate.md)**
  – Computes target-based shocks by comparing initial and target
  datasets, automatically **exporting the resulting shocks to `.HAR`
  files** with dynamic timeline headers (e.g., `ONEY`, `TWOY`, `THRY`,
  etc.).  
- **[`create_initial_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_initial_config.md)**,
  **[`create_target_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_target_config.md)**,
  and
  **[`create_calc_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_calc_config.md)**
  – Define input sources, column mappings, and timeline periods for use
  in both uniform and target-based shock calculations.

## GTAP Database

Sample data used in this [vignette](https://rpubs.com/Bodysbob/1273998/)
is obtained from the GTAPv7 model and utilizes publicly available data
from the [GTAP 9
database](https://www.gtap.agecon.purdue.edu/databases/archives.asp).
For more details about the GTAP database and model, refer to the **[GTAP
Database](https://www.gtap.agecon.purdue.edu/)**.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Older Version

## Version 1.1.3 - Update (30-Oct-2025)

- **Writing HAR files without limitations** – The new
  [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  function fully supports writing `.HAR` files with no size
  restrictions, allowing up to seven dimensions and approximately two
  million elements per chunk.  
- **Shock calculation and HAR export** – Introduced
  [`shock_calculate_uniform()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate_uniform.md)
  and
  [`shock_calculate()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate.md)
  to compute and **export shock results directly into GEMPACK-compatible
  `.HAR` files**, supporting dynamic multi-period calculations (e.g.,
  `ONEY`, `TWOY`, `THRY`, etc.) for recursive-dynamic simulations.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`compare_var_structure()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/compare_var_structure.md)
  : Compare Variable Structures Across SL4 and HAR Objects
- [`create_calc_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_calc_config.md)
  : Create Calculation Configuration
- [`create_initial_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_initial_config.md)
  : Create Initial Value Configuration
- [`create_target_config()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/create_target_config.md)
  : Create Target Value Configuration
- [`export_data()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/export_data.md)
  : Export Data to Various Formats (CSV/STATA/TEXT/RDS/XLSX)
- [`get_data_by_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_data_by_dims.md)
  : Extract Data by Dimension Patterns from SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`get_data_by_var()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_data_by_var.md)
  : Extract Variable Data from SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`get_dim_elements()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_dim_elements.md)
  : Get Dimension Elements from SL4 and HAR Objects
- [`get_dim_patterns()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_dim_patterns.md)
  : Get Dimension Patterns from SL4 and HAR Objects
- [`get_var_structure()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/get_var_structure.md)
  : Get Variable Structure Summary from SL4 and HAR Objects
- [`group_data_by_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/group_data_by_dims.md)
  : Group Data by Dimension Patterns in SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`load_harx()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_harx.md)
  : Load and Process HAR Files with Header Selection
- [`load_sl4x()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/load_sl4x.md)
  : Load and Process SL4 Files with Enhanced Options
- [`pivot_data()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/pivot_data.md)
  : Pivot Data from SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`pivot_data_hierarchy()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/pivot_data_hierarchy.md)
  : Create Hierarchical Pivot Table from SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`rename_dims()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/rename_dims.md)
  : Rename Dimensions in SL4 or HAR Objects
- [`save_har()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/save_har.md)
  : Save Data to GEMPACK HAR Format
- [`shock_calculate()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate.md)
  : Calculate Shocks from Initial and Target Values
- [`shock_calculate_uniform()`](https://bodysbobb.github.io/HARplus/reference/shock_calculate_uniform.md)
  : Calculate Shocks with Uniform Adjustment
